body.name: intrinsic recursive-frontier handle
body.construction: Apply \(\mathsf{FrontierHandle}\) to the windmill family by proving \(\mathfrak H_{\ell,d}(S)\ne0\) for every degree-\(d\) recursively reachable \(S\subseteq\theta_{W_{\ell}^{(2)}}\setminus\{\zeta_{\ell}\}\), including sets containing disturbance coordinates, and compare the resulting lower scale with the graph-uniform Hilbert bound from the multigraded graph algebra of \(\phi_G\).
